(REVIEW_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR REVIEW_CTT LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%')
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_REVIEW_NO.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO REVIEW_BOARD ( REVIEW_NO, USER_ID, REVIEW_RATING, REVIEW_CTT, REVIEW_CREATED, REVIEW_UPDATE, ORDER_NO, REVIEW_TITLE, REVIEW_HIT ) VALUES ( #{reviewNo}, #{userId}, #{reviewRating}, #{reviewCtt}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, #{orderNo}, #{reviewTitle}, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE REVIEW_BOARD SET REVIEW_TITLE = #{reviewTitle}, REVIEW_CTT = #{reviewCtt}, REVIEW_RATING = #{reviewRating}, REVIEW_UPDATE = SYSDATE WHERE REVIEW_NO = #{reviewNo} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT o.ORDER_NO as orderNo, rp.REG_TITLE as regTitle FROM ORDERS o JOIN ORDER_ITEM oi ON o.ORDER_NO = oi.ORDER_NO JOIN REGISTER_PROD rp ON rp.REG_ID = oi.REG_ID WHERE o.USER_ID = #{value} AND o.ORDER_STATUS IN ('PAID') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM REVIEW_BOARD r WHERE r.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO ) ORDER BY o.ORDER_DATE DESC

SELECT r.REVIEW_NO, r.USER_ID, r.REVIEW_RATING, r.REVIEW_TITLE, r.REVIEW_CTT, r.REVIEW_HIT, r.ORDER_NO, r.REVIEW_CREATED, TO_CHAR(r.REVIEW_UPDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS REVIEW_UPDATE_STR, TO_CHAR(r.REVIEW_CREATED,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS REVIEW_CREATED_STR,
-- ✅ 주문의 대표 상품명(주문에 여러 상품이면 MAX로 하나만) (SELECT MAX(rp.REG_TITLE) FROM ORDER_ITEM oi JOIN REGISTER_PROD rp ON rp.REG_ID = oi.REG_ID WHERE oi.ORDER_NO = r.ORDER_NO ) AS REG_TITLE FROM REVIEW_BOARD r WHERE r.REVIEW_NO = #{value}

SELECT rb.REVIEW_NO AS reviewNo , rb.ORDER_NO AS orderNo , rb.REVIEW_TITLE AS reviewTitle , rb.REVIEW_CTT AS reviewCtt , rb.REVIEW_RATING AS rating , rb.REVIEW_CREATED AS reviewCreated , rb.REVIEW_HIT AS reviewHit
, oi.REG_ID AS regId , rp.REG_TITLE AS regTitle
FROM REVIEW_BOARD rb LEFT JOIN ORDERS o ON o.ORDER_NO = rb.ORDER_NO LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM oi ON oi.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO LEFT JOIN REGISTER_PROD rp ON rp.REG_ID = oi.REG_ID
WHERE rb.USER_ID = #{value} AND NVL(rb.DEL_YN, 'N') = 'N'
ORDER BY rb.REVIEW_CREATED DESC, rb.REVIEW_NO DESC
